Bio

The Jugs are a zany punk trio from Logan, UT. Since their formation in March of 2025, their live shows have served as a haven for the Northern Utah underground scene, echoing the goofball stage presence of The Aquabats or The Dead Milkmen. With strong influences from other 80s hardcore bands like Minor Threat or Bad Brains, The Jugs bring a similar intensity to their music, but a noticeably unserious attitude to much of their lyrical content and on-stage bits.
